definition: An optical neural network is a physical implementation of an artificial neural network with optical components.
details: Early optical neural networks used a photorefractive Volume hologram to interconnect arrays of input neurons to arrays of output with synaptic weights in proportion to the multiplexed hologram's strength. Volume holograms were further multiplexed using spectral hole burning to add one dimension of wavelength to space to achieve four dimensional interconnects of two dimensional arrays of neural inputs and outputs. This research led to extensive research on alternative methods using the strength of the optical interconnect for implementing neuronal communications. Some artificial neural networks that have been implemented as optical neural networks include the Hopfield neural network and the Kohonen self-organizing map with liquid crystal spatial light modulators Optical neural networks can also be based on the principles of neuromorphic engineering, creating neuromorphic photonic systems. Typically, these systems encode information in the networks using spikes, mimicking the functionality of spiking neural networks in optical and photonic hardware. explainer.lead: It is a physical implementation of an artificial neural network built from optical components. It matters as an alternative hardware route whose synaptic weights are set by optical elements rather than electronic ones.

tiers.eli5: It's a neural network made of light and lenses instead of wires and chips.
tiers.practitioner: Weights are encoded in optical elements such as holograms that interconnect input and output neuron arrays; scaling to many neurons and maintaining stable weights are recurring difficulties.
tiers.paperLevel: Input neurons are interconnected to output neurons by optical elements whose strength sets the synaptic weight; early systems used photorefractive volume holograms multiplexed by spectral hole burning to give four-dimensional interconnects of two-dimensional arrays. No stated accuracy guarantee.

explainer.example: A volume hologram interconnects an array of input neurons to an array of output neurons, with synaptic weights proportional to the hologram's strength.
